tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind every screen. Grounds: ink, ink-muted, accent, accent-2, type-*, streak, success, danger and rarity-* text all read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: stat tiles, cards, tab bar, sheets. Same text pairs as bg.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Inner frames (card art window), chips, inputs, empty segments ground. Same text pairs as bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, HUD labels (WEIGHT, NEXT 03/15), captions on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative panel borders and dividers only. Never the only thing that marks a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Meaningful borders: the dashed empty/locked card slot, input outlines, unselected chip outlines. 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, selected tab text, links, lit progress segments. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (primary Button, selected chip).

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Second highlight: streak numeral, celebration call-outs. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: on-accent-2
tokens.usage: Text on accent-2 fills.

tokens.name: type-distance
tokens.usage: Distance: segments, chart bars, type pip, numerals. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: on-type-distance
tokens.usage: Text on type-distance fills (type picker selected segment).

tokens.name: type-weight
tokens.usage: Weight: numerals, bars, pip. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: on-type-weight
tokens.usage: Text on type-weight fills.

tokens.name: type-duration
tokens.usage: Duration: numerals, bars, pip. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: on-type-duration
tokens.usage: Text on type-duration fills.

tokens.name: type-reps
tokens.usage: Reps: numerals, bars, pip. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: on-type-reps
tokens.usage: Text on type-reps fills.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unlit progress segments and chart track. Lit segments (type-* or accent) hold 3:1 against it.

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: Weekly streak numeral and shield icon. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved / unlocked confirmations, always with a word or check icon. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive settings rows and validation text, always with a word. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset. 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Common card frame and tag fill (first 40% of a type's milestones). As text on bg, surface, surface-alt; tag text uses on-rarity.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare card frame and tag fill (next 30%). As text on bg, surface, surface-alt; tag text uses on-rarity.

tokens.name: rarity-epic
tokens.usage: Epic card frame and tag fill (next 20%). As text on bg, surface, surface-alt; tag text uses on-rarity.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary card frame and tag fill (top 10%). As text on bg, surface, surface-alt; tag text uses on-rarity.

tokens.name: on-rarity
tokens.usage: Text on rarity-* tag fills (COMMON, RARE, EPIC, LEGENDARY).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Center of the radial glow behind card art inside surface-alt frames; fades to surface-alt. Never behind text.

tokens.name: gradient-start
tokens.usage: First stop of the featured-card border and LogButton gradient (cyan).

tokens.name: gradient-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the brand gradient (violet). The only gradient in the system.

tokens.name: gradient-end
tokens.usage: Last stop of the brand gradient (magenta).

tokens.name: on-gradient
tokens.usage: The + glyph on the LogButton gradient fill (icon, 3:1 on every stop).

tokens.name: rank
tokens.usage: Level chip outline and text (LVL 4 · SILVER) and the lit tier pips. Text on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Dynamic Island and other always-black system chrome only. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-device
tokens.usage: Primary text on device.

tokens.name: device-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary HUD labels on device.

tokens.name: device-accent
tokens.usage: Distance numerals and the progress pip on device (cyan stays bright because device is always black).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Featured card title and Celebration card title. Always uppercase (bundle.css sets text-transform). ink on surface.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles: rank title, empty-state heading, sheet title. Uppercase.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels and button labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, challenge name, ticker lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: That's about 270 blue whales lined up nose to tail!

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasized body: activity row primary line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under numerals and rows.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Big rounded numerals in stat panels and streak (unit words ride along at the same size).

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Numerals in widgets, list trailing values and records.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: HUD labels above panels and counters. Uppercase.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: Readouts under the featured card and in Live Activity. Uppercase.

styles.name: hud-strong
styles.usage: Rarity tags, level chip, segmented picker labels. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px step. Gaps between segments and pips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px step. Inner gaps in rows and stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px step. Gap between panels and card slots.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px step. Panel padding and screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px step. Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px step. Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px step. Space above section headers.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 48px step. Empty-state and celebration breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rarity tags, level chip, segments' parent picker items, pips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, card slots, buttons, inputs, LogButton.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Featured card, tab bar, sheets, share card, widgets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and switches only.

tokens.name: shadow-neon
tokens.usage: Featured card and revealed card only: a soft cyan halo in Arcade, a lift in Daylight.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels. Arcade panels are flat (borders do the work); Daylight adds a hairline lift.
